name: SignGraph handles channels, messages, resources and resource exchange through Ports
asks: improve the ability of signgraph to handle channels, messages, resources, resource exchange, so that signcraft is more able to handle multicellular structures, complex resource flows

met-when.says: A Port is constructed from a finite set of message kinds and an independence relation on them, as the glossary defines it, and is a frozen value.
Offering a Port a message whose kind it does not list returns a typed refusal naming the Port and the kind, and changes nothing.
Two messages the Port's independence relation relates give the same graph in either order of delivery; two it does not relate keep their order.
Two graphs that share a Port compose into one graph across it; the composite's cells are exactly the cells of both, and every message that crossed the Port is a cell of the composite.

An exchange of a resource between two cells across a Port is conserved: the composite graph holds what left one side as what arrived at the other, in exact numbers, and an exchange that would not balance is refused.
